messages:
julia: CI red on PR #6321 — build job failing at push stage. Buildx exits with 429 / too many requests from registry.redwood.internal. full log: 'error: failed to push: response status: 429 Too Many Requests' and then 'unexpected EOF' after some chunks. job: https://ci.internal.redwood/9023 :facepalm:
ci-bot: build 9023 failed at push step (buildx). see logs above.
ken: which step changed in the PR? Dockerfile diff looked minor — just reordered apt installs? :eyes:
julia: Dockerfile change: switched to multi-arch buildx and added an apt layer with cache-busting arg. also enabled parallel push for platforms. I suspect concurrent uploads + registry quota. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6321
mike: registry is our internal GCR gateway? we've had rate-limits recently when many branches push concurrently. can you paste the error block?
julia: paste: ```WARN[0000] pushing to registry.redwood.internal/library/app:sha256:... 
error: failed to push: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to upload chunk: 429 Too Many Requests
caused by: unexpected EOF```
ana: (typo) ana: we rotated the deploy SA keys last week, but that causes 401s not 429. this looks like rate-limiting on the registry side.
sre-oncall: quick triage: 1) try rerun with exponential backoff retry around buildx push 2) reduce push concurrency / do per-platform pushes 3) clear buildx cache/worker to avoid many simultaneous uploads 4) check registry-side quota dashboard. can someone try a rerun with a retry wrapper?
ken: simple retry wrapper in GH Actions: ```- name: build+push
  run: |
    for i in 1 2 3; do 
      docker buildx build --push --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t registry.redwood.internal/app:$GIT_SHA . && break || sleep $((i*15));
    done```
mike: also try forcing sequential pushes: build for amd64 then arm64 and push separately as a quick test. reduces concurrent upload pressure.
julia: doing a manual rerun now with the retry loop. moving buildx to a single builder instance and adding sleep. will report back. :thumbsup:
--- 5m later ---
julia: rerun succeeded. push completed after 2nd attempt. logs show initial 429 then success on retry. changing CI to include 3x backoff + per-arch sequential fallback. I'll open a follow-up PR to revert parallel push until registry scaling is improved. thanks all. :tada:
